Net Asset Value(s) | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Net Asset Value(s) AI Summary Close X The North American Income Trust reports net asset values at close of 26 November 2026 of 444.6p per share including current financial year revenue (debt at fair value 448.9p) and 438.6p excluding current financial year revenue (debt at fair value 443.0p). Calculations use AIC methodology and exclude shares held in treasury. Debt fair value is an estimate derived from a discount rate based on US Treasury redemption yields plus a credit spread determined from month‑end differences in ICE BofA 3–5 Year Single‑A US Corporate and 5–10 Year Single‑A US Corporate indices for the 2030 and 2035 senior unsecured notes; the discount rate is updated monthly and applied daily.
